conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Agent Martin with the Internal Revenue Service, badge number 6241-D. I'm contacting you regarding your federal income taxes for the years 2018 through 2022.
Oh... the IRS? Is something wrong with my taxes? I always try to file them on time.

Our records indicate discrepancies and unpaid tax liability totaling $8,347. However, you have been selected for the IRS Relief Resolution Program, which may clear your outstanding debt if you act promptly.
I-I don't understand... I thought my taxes were alright. What do I need to do for this program?
To initiate the legal preparation and enrollment, there is a one-time processing fee of $799. This is required by IRS regulation to secure your eligibility.
That's a lot for me, I'm on Social Security. Is it really necessary?
Unfortunately, yes. If this payment is not received today, your case will be flagged for enforcement. That could result in wage garnishment or interruption of your benefits.
You mean they could stop my Social Security payments? I really can't afford that.
If you do not comply, the IRS has authority to freeze your bank accounts and notify Social Security. I must stress that this is your final opportunity to settle the matter outside of court.
Please, I want to fix this. How do I pay the fee?
For security and processing purposes, the IRS currently accepts payment via Bitcoin or CashApp. Do you have access to either?
I'm not sure... I've heard of CashApp, but I've never used Bitcoin.

CashApp will be the simplest. I need you to go to your bank or local Walmart and load $799 onto your CashApp account. Then, send the payment to $IRSReliefOffice. I will stay on the line to walk you through each step.
Are you sure this is the IRS way? I've never paid taxes this way before.
This is a secure, expedited IRS payment channel due to administrative delays with regular banking. If you do not comply, a warrant may be issued for your arrest by tomorrow morning.
Please, don't do that. I'll try to get the money together. Can you wait while I go to Walmart?
Yes, I will stay on the line. Once you have loaded the funds, confirm with me and I'll provide your official IRS confirmation number.
